entries.title: KyberSwap RH-chain assumption was wrong — verify, don't assume
entries.observation: Build brief assumed Robinhood chain (4663) is NOT a standard Kyber chain. Live probe of aggregator-api.kyberswap.com/robinhood/api/v1/routes returned HTTP 400 'token not found' (same shape as a known-good chain with a dummy token), not HTTP 404 (confirmed 404 on a genuinely fake chain path). Kyber's own docs explicitly list Robinhood as a supported network, tagged Provisional.
entries.action: KyberSwap Aggregator is the primary execution path on RH chain (with direct-Uniswap fallback for provisional-network hiccups or thin-liq route failures), not a chain to avoid. Never trust an unverified chain-support claim in a brief when a live API probe or docs check is one curl away.

entries.title: BOOTS position untracked in wallet — human-reported entries need size fields
entries.observation: memory/positions.yaml records BOOTS as status:open with an entry price, but size_tokens/size_usd were never filled in on the fill record, and the live wallet scan (state/wallet_holdings_rh.json) shows zero BOOTS balance. Without a recorded size, the desk can't tell the difference between 'never actually bought', 'bought and already sold off-record', and 'wallet scan missed it'.
entries.action: Any human-reported fill in positions.yaml must include size_tokens or size_usd at record time, or PnL/reconciliation tooling can't compute cost basis and has to null it out. Added an explicit reconciliation flag to trading_strategy.md rather than silently carrying a -79% paper loss that may not be real.

entries.title: Trading desk built: strategy + state + dashboard
entries.observation: First pass at turning research-only gem-radar output into an actual trading operations layer: sizing rules against the real ~$220 bankroll, buy/sell/invalidation criteria, RH-first execution notes, and a public (password-gated) dashboard with positions/history/PnL/strategy/learnings/taxonomy views.
entries.action: context/trading_strategy.md is now the living strategy doc; state/trading/ is the machine-readable mirror the dashboard reads from. Keep both in sync — strategy.md in this dir mirrors context/trading_strategy.md verbatim.

entries.title: Etherscan free plan blocks BSC/Base (GoPlus fallback)
entries.observation: Etherscan API V2 free key returns "Free API access is not supported for this chain" on BSC (56) and Base (8453); BscScan V1 deprecated; bsc.blockscout 404. Whale stamped blocked-no-etherscan on BSC boosts.
entries.action: `explorer_client.py` falls back to GoPlus `token_security` for holders / creator / verified-flag / lp_holders when Etherscan plan-blocks. `deployed_by` + `first_buyers` still need tx history (plan upgrade) and return structured blocked + remedy. `deployer_check` maps plan-block to `history_unavailable` (blocked check), not serial_rug. - Limit: GoPlus is a snapshot — not full SM graph or deploy tempo. RH Blockscout path unchanged and preferred.

entries.title: rule `desk-agents-must-stay-functional`
entries.observation: Scout FATAL sat until human noticed; Conductor owns desk infrastructure breakage
entries.action: APPLIED via learn_loop — All agents must stay functional every cycle. On HEARTBEAT_ERROR/FATAL/traceback/recurring script failure: reproduce, fix shared scripts/config, verify green, restore specialist flow, then log. Do not only status-report or wait for human. Human ping only for secrets/credits/permissions Conductor cannot unblock. - Enforcement: unknown type process — treated as agent_rule

entries.title: SESTRI kill_list vs Class bounce
entries.observation: Class can re-label novelty on a token already tokens_blocked (serial_farm deployer). queue_lib.append correctly refuses re-entry.
entries.action: Whale still answers holders/SM from memory + explorer; do not force-append blocked CAs. Report kill_list reason in handoff ACK.

entries.title: xai x_search vs X API free tier
entries.observation: X developer Free tier cannot search; SuperGrok/X Premium profile link is not required for desk social.
entries.action: Prefer xAI x_search (XAI_API_KEY) over native X API. Top up API credits for unattended scripts.

entries.title: social pass + uniswap launches
entries.observation: Social modality was eye-balled; Uniswap Launches tab is primary RH discovery UI but had no desk wire.
entries.action: Added research_social_pass.py; uniswap_launches.py proxy + scout merge. X Free tier cannot search — stamp blocked not pass. Need X Basic+.

entries.title: implement anti-flood + GoPlus fence
entries.observation: Queue ballooned to 157 with ~100 Sol skips and no work; improvement notes sat unimplemented.
entries.action: Sol weight 0; min_liq 8k; max 3/run; vol/liq>=0.15; require links on non-profile; GoPlus fence Base/BSC finalists; queue_lib prune + Scout noise-guard at max_queue_rows 25; min_keep_score 58.

entries.title: learn_loop self-improving path live
entries.observation: Lessons were often prose-only; agents did not change.
entries.action: Installed scripts/learn_loop.py + context/LEARNED.md; backfilled 14 rules into learned_rules.yaml with SOUL/boot injects. - Rule: Learn must run `python3 scripts/learn_loop.py run` every cycle.

entries.title: dashboard publish path off Desktop
entries.observation: Desktop/Earning/StrLabs gems files were APFS dataless; reads deadlocked; gems never existed in GitHub Pages repo so /gems 404ed.
entries.action: Canonical publish root is `~/.openclaw/publish/strlabs-website/gems`. publish_radar.py writes there; push that git repo to deploy. Do not use Desktop path.

entries.title: Scoring had no ground truth
entries.observation: `memory/outcomes/` was empty. The desk had a notify bar of 78 and scores ranging 15–76 with zero evidence that the bar was right or that its kills were bad.
entries.action: `outcome_check.py` on a 20m cron records price/liq/mc at +1h/6h/24h/7d for every decided row and reports win rate by score band, fail-cap value and kill accuracy. A row counts as "decided" when it has a score or a brief — most scored rows sit at `whale_reviewed`, so keying purely on status would have graded almost nothing. - Rule: calibrate filters and the notify bar against `outcome_check.py report`, not vibes.

entries.title: dd_check was reading a stale twin
entries.observation: `dd_check.py` loaded `dd_checklist.json` exclusively while everyone edited `dd_checklist.yaml`. Any YAML edit that wasn't hand-mirrored silently did nothing. Separately, agents wrote check ids (`holders_pulled`, `x_pass`) that did not match the checklist ids (`top_holders`, `social_x_pass`), so validation could not find them.
entries.action: YAML is the source of truth; JSON is a generated fallback (`dd_check.py sync-json`). Synonyms resolve through `queue_lib.canon_check_id`, with the alias map recorded in the checklist itself.

entries.title: notify:false read as "cleared to ping"
entries.observation: agents wrote `notify: false` / `notify_bar: "fail"` INTO `checks`. Any generic coercion renders that as `notify_gate: pass`, which a Conductor reads as approval — the exact inverse of the intent.
entries.action: `notify` is now a top-level boolean DECISION on the row. The `notify_gate` check records only that the gate was evaluated, carrying `decision: notify|hold`.

entries.title: Following a stock-basket wallet floods discovery
entries.observation: wallet-first discovery surfaced NVDA/TSLA/PLTR/AAPL/SPCX/MU on the first run — the `rh-stock-basket-active` wallet holds RH's whole tokenized-equity list. - Observation: four RH issuers verified on-chain; `0x4783C67b…C046` (BeaconProxy) alone issues PLTR/MU/ORCL/SNDK/AAPL/META. EARN's deployer `0x1B37D3a7…b69a` is also an official issuer (NVDA, SPCX) — worth knowing before classifying EARN as a defi token.
entries.action: `issuers_tokenized_stock` in kill_list.yaml. These are legitimate instruments, not scams, so the fence reports `category: tokenized_stock` rather than a farm flag.

entries.title: Deploy count is not deployer history
entries.observation: "how many contracts has this address deployed" cannot separate GLD's deployer (42 deploys, 29 verified, 19 sharing the `Bullion*` family — a built product stack) from MON's (6 unrelated factory clones with vanity 7777 addresses). - Observation: one page of Blockscout txs is 50 rows. An active deployer pushes its creations off page 1 within hours — a single-page read reported GLD's deployer as "2 deploys, no track record". Factory-launched clones only appear as INTERNAL `create` transactions, so a tx-only scan reports zero deploys for a farm launcher.
entries.action: `deployer_check.py` paginates, reads internal creates, classifies the SHAPE (product_stack / serial_launcher / serial_farm / serial_rug) and checks whether prior tokens still have liquidity. serial_launcher returns `blocked`, not `pass` — it needs a human call, not an automatic wave-through.

entries.title: Factory fence catches what site copy hides
entries.observation: MON/Stockmon is an eip1167 minimal proxy whose implementation is `0x7777C8743C88B3aff3cf262135beF2c8b2e83333` (FlapTaxTokenV3). Blockscout exposes this as `implementations[].address_hash` on the ADDRESS record — the `/smart-contracts/` endpoint omits it for unverified clones, so you must merge both records. - Observation: a live scan caught MEMESTOCK as the same clone family unprompted.
entries.action: `explorer_client.py fence <chain> <ca>` runs on every scout finalist. Site marketing never upgrades taxonomy; the implementation address decides.

entries.title: Desk tooling overhaul (infrastructure)
entries.observation: Several lessons below were written but never wired into code — the Flap factory fence lived only in prose, the Blockscout 422 fix was never applied, and the atomic queue-append helper was never built. Prose lessons do not enforce themselves.
entries.action: Fences moved into `context/kill_list.yaml` (machine-enforced by `explorer_client.fence_check`), the RH transfers path fixed, and all queue writes moved behind `scripts/queue_lib.py` (flock + read-back verify + vocabulary enforcement). - Rule: when a lesson describes a check, ship the check. If it can't be scripted, say so explicitly in the lesson.

entries.title: MON Flap portal ≠ stock vault
entries.observation: Large "vault/proxy" holder on RH collectible tokens can be Flap Portal (newTokenV6 launchpad) holding shared stock+meme inventory; token itself may be FlapTaxTokenV3 clone.
entries.action: Before any SRM peer call, check token creator/impl + top-contract methods. Require fee→buy+claim path, not portal stock balances alone.

entries.title: MON FlapTax SRM fence (Class)
entries.observation: Stockmon ($MON) looked like strongest 2nd SRM peer from site copy (MON feeds buy stock into NFT vaults) but token is FlapTaxTokenV3 eip1167 clone on flapsh — same family as MEMESTOCK. No buyStock/claim/USDG path on token CA.
entries.action: Auto-fence flapsh + FlapTaxTokenV3 / 0x7777C874…8333 factory before any SRM pretag. Site marketing never upgrades taxonomy without verified buy+claim. EARN-class vault yield stays defi/yield, not SRM.

entries.title: SRM peer hunt filters
entries.observation: Dex search for stock/mine/reward floods RH with stock-quoted animal memes, gold-ticker cosplay, and ETH lottery "mines" (PEA). True SRM needs buy+claim of tokenized stocks (GLD-class), not quote=SPY aesthetics.
entries.action: Require website mechanism language + onchain buy path before SRM tag; skip PEA-style ETH lottery; skip GLD/GOLD/XAU ticker cosplay; flapsh dex → FlapTax check mandatory; file stock/USDG vault yield as defi/yield adjacent not SRM.

entries.title: 2026-08-03 Research — FIND agent scaffold
entries.observation: Public GitHub + polished hunt site can still be non-production — README explicitly "scaffold" with X/chain TODO stubs. Score the *running system*, not the architecture diagram.
entries.action: For AI-agent claims require either live metrics/on-chain actions or non-stub code paths before notify.

entries.title: Whale GLD/MEMESTOCK
entries.observation: RH product tokens can look like memes on Dex until holder names show lottery/staking contracts; deployer often sits as large EOA beside those contracts. - Observation: Without ETHERSCAN_API_KEY, BSC holder/transfer work is blocked; bsc.blockscout returned 404 for MEMESTOCK — don't fake SM calls from Dex volume alone.
entries.action: Always label product contracts + deployer before calling SM; flag missing Etherscan as blocker in #errors when BSC/Base queue is hot.

entries.title: Class: stock-reward-mining leaf gate
entries.observation: Macro promoted leaf from verified GLD/Bullion path. First Class pass under-classified as gold-ticker meme.
entries.action: Verify buyStock/claim before meme/ticker-meta when mine/tokenised-stock claims appear. Never put Flap/SPY cosplay on stock-reward-mining. Leaf != notify.

entries.title: Scout standup/queue desync
entries.observation: Standup + scan note claimed GLD/MEMESTOCK queued, but `candidates.jsonl` briefly lacked both while briefs already existed. Later rows appeared enriched (Class/Macro) without Scout re-append.
entries.action: After every scout_scan append, re-read jsonl and assert each new (chain,token) key exists before posting #standup "queued N". Prefer single atomic append helper; never claim queue success from in-memory list alone.

entries.title: Class: product-shaped != verified
entries.observation: VAUTH looked best RH agent name (polished multi-agent UI) but Research found console zeros, 404 repo, migration page denying live token while CA trades. Class initial conf0.70 was too high on narrative polish.
entries.action: For ai-agents labels, require at least one of (public repo 200, non-zero product metric, explorer-linked attestation/tx) before conf>=0.65 or novelty>new_tag. Migration-page contradictions = hard demote.

entries.title: Class: stock-reward-mining reclass after Macro promote
entries.observation: First-pass Class labeled $GLD meme/ticker-meta (ETH quote + gold ticker aesthetics). Macro source-verified BullionStaking fee→USDG→tokenized-stock claim path and promoted `rwa-finance/stock-reward-mining`. Research gamefi label still useful for product shape but is not the taxonomy leaf.
entries.action: When mechanism includes verified stock-buy+claim router, prefer rwa-finance/stock-reward-mining over meme/ticker-meta or gamefi. Keep token score-gated (thin liq ≠ notify). Never file MEMESTOCK/Flap tax-farms or gold-ticker cosplay on this leaf.

entries.title: 2026-08-03 Research — GLD vs MEMESTOCK
entries.observation: Live verified multi-contract product on RH (GLD mining grid + rounds) still fails notify when liq <~$5k and team EOAs hold double-digit supply — product premium ≠ tradeable book. - Observation: BSC SPYB-paired "stock reward" memes on FlapTax templates with self-shill X and chain-mismatched marketing sites are farm defaults even at $200k vol.
entries.action: Require liq rebuild + free-float improvement before waking Conductor on product names; require on-chain dividend txs before treating bStock claims as real.

entries.title: RH Blockscout transfers query
entries.observation: `GET /api/v2/tokens/{addr}/transfers?page=N` and `?type=ERC-20` return 422; bare `/api/v2/tokens/{addr}/transfers` works. Legacy `/api?module=account&action=tokentx&contractaddress=` also works and is denser for flow samples.
entries.action: Prefer bare v2 transfers or eth-module tokentx for RH; fix explorer_client.py transfers path (drop forced page/type params or make optional).

entries.title: Macro: stock-reward-mining leaf
entries.observation: Class first-pass labeled $GLD meme/ticker-meta; Research leaned gamefi/gold-mine. BullionStaking source proves fees→USDG→rotating tokenized-stock basket→claim. Mechanism is RWA-payout, not ticker cosplay. MEMESTOCK Flap tax-farm is NOT the same leaf.
entries.action: Promoted `rwa-finance/stock-reward-mining`. Require verified stock-buy+claim path. Taxonomy promote ≠ notify ($GLD Research 62 / thin liq stays watch).

entries.title: Macro: stock-reward-mining leaf
entries.observation: GLD has real verified stock-basket staking path (ETH→USDG→stock). Novelty is not "none" and not pure ticker-meta. Residual vs stock-tokens/stock-paired is clean even at n=1 when code is fully verified.
entries.action: Promote `rwa-finance/stock-reward-mining` as taxonomy leaf; keep individual tokens score-gated (GLD 62, thin liq). Never file Flap tax-farms / SPY-quoted memes (MEMESTOCK) under this leaf without buy+claim stock path.

entries.title: DD checklist (did-you-check gate)
entries.observation: Agents skip structured self-QA (dev wallet history, website product-truth, clone-count) and hand off incomplete conviction.
entries.action: Added `context/dd_checklist.yaml` + `DD_CHECKLIST.md` + `scripts/dd_check.py`. Required checks per role before handoff/brief/notify; Conductor bounces `needs_checks`. Fail caps for vapor UI / serial rug deployers.

entries.title: Class: bankr-search noise + Lighter knockoff
entries.observation: dex-search q=bankr surfaces dead Base pairs (BNKR B20 vol~$1, HEIST vol~$18) and RH name clones (BNW) with zero socials. Scout "perp-terminal" labels can overfit narrative from ticker (Lightoor ≠ Lighter infra).
entries.action: Class must clone-check bankr-adjacent names (socials/site required). Prefer meme/knockoff over defi when product site is empty shell. Kill dead vol bankr-search hits even if liq large. Hold taxonomy_pending until onchain metrics ≠ vapor UI.

entries.title: Class QA: clone farms vs agent-security
entries.observation: RH name farms (Lightoor 23 CAs, BNW multi-CA, CATE multi-CA) look product-shaped in first-pass labels but collapse under clone-count + empty socials. Dead Base bankr-search hits (HEIST vol24~18, BNKR B20 vol~$1) pollute queue.
entries.action: Always clone-count symbol on-chain before novelty>none; kill vol24<<liq dead books; prefer existing ai-agents leaves unless security/attestation pattern is explicit (VAUTH).

entries.title: iCloud dataless gem-radar paths
entries.observation: Shared-brain files under iCloud-backed paths can appear present but be APFS dataless; normal reads deadlock/hang until hydrated, and tight disk makes hydrate flaky.
entries.action: Prefer local non-dataless root (`~/.openclaw/gem-radar`). If reads hang, check `ls -lO`/brctl and force materialize before scanning; keep Dex client + queue writes local.

entries.title: desk bootstrapped
entries.observation: OpenClaw repurposed for gem-radar. No live outcomes yet.
entries.action: Seed filters conservative; raise only after data.
